contents.text: What was Microsoft's net income in fiscal year 2025?
Microsoft's net income in fiscal year 2025 was $101,832 million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA)
